description: React Native uses React ideas to build mobile app screens. Its View and Text components are different from web HTML. Learn a small screen, clear controls and a reading list using core mobile components. Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.
versionNote: Uses stable React Native core components and react-native-safe-area-context for screen insets.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the title fontSize to 28
Learn to change row to column and compare the layout
Learn to change the pressed colour while keeping text readable
